usedFor: Qminder runs the visitor queue, and Zendesk Support opens a ticket through “Create Support Ticket” when a “visitor checks in”.

bestTemplate.name: “visitor checks in” in Qminder, then “Create Support Ticket” in Zendesk Support
bestTemplate.why: A check-in becomes a ticket with requester, priority and tags, so the front desk and support share one record.

watchOut: “Add visitor to queue” and “Mark visitor as served” are separate triggers, so wire one or visitors get several tickets.
